title: Verifiable Retrieval for Legal Reasoning through Structure-driven Knowledge Graph
abstract: arXiv:2610.13695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Any automation within reliability-critical contexts such as medicine or law has to be transparent and verifiable. Despite their advantages, current LLM-based systems do not meet these requirements due to their inherent black-box nature. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to ground the generative process in the relevant interpretable documents, thereby reducing the risk of AI 'hallucinations' and potentially enabling verification of the initial generation context. However, as the number and size of potential sources increases, naive retrieval approaches tend to perform worse, ignoring critical context elements. translated_title: 基于结构驱动知识图谱的法律推理可验证检索
translated_abstract: 在医学或法律等可靠性至关重要的场景中，任何自动化系统都必须是透明且可验证的。尽管当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统具有诸多优势，但由于其固有的黑箱特性，它们无法满足这些要求。检索增强生成（RAG）试图将生成过程建立在相关可解释文档的基础上，从而降低AI“幻觉”的风险，并有可能实现对初始生成上下文的验证。然而，随着潜在信息来源数量和规模的增加，朴素的检索方法往往表现变差，会忽略关键的上下文元素。本文旨在德国法律法典的背景下解决这一问题。我们使用结构驱动的解析方法创建知识图谱（KG）用于源文档的导航和检索，比较了多种基于知识图谱的分块和检索策略，并评估了它们对检索引用准确性的影响。
tldr: 本文提出利用结构驱动解析为德国法律法典构建知识图谱，通过比较多种基于知识图谱的分块与检索策略，提升了法律推理场景中引用检索的准确性和可验证性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes building a Knowledge Graph via structure-driven parsing of the German Legal Code, comparing several KG-informed chunking and retrieval strategies to improve the accuracy and verifiability of citation retrieval for legal reasoning.
